summary: Master effective sales techniques tailored for the hotel and tourism industry. Join our training course and transform your approach to customer engagement!
lede: Sales Techniques for Hotel and Tourism Professionals helps front desk, reservations, tour, conference, lodge, and destination-experience teams turn inquiries into confirmed, paid bookings. Participants learn to qualify leads, communicate value beyond price, handle objections and competitor comparisons, and close with confidence. The course builds practical skills in upselling and cross-selling, helping professionals increase guest spend without pressure tactics. It also shows teams how to follow up systematically, build relationships that support corporate accounts, repeat guests, and referrals, and track sales performance for continuous improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the hospitality and tourism sectors, who aim to boost their sales capabilities and drive revenue.
audience: Front office managers and guest relations staff
Tour operators and safari company sales coordinators
modules: Selling to Corporate Clients and Groups
Follow-Up Systems and Lost Booking Recovery
Selling Across Channels: Phone, Email, Walk-In, and Digital
Sales Performance Tracking and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in the hospitality or tourism industry. Familiarity with sales processes and customer service is recommended.
